facts.fact: The Minister of State for Health told the National Council on Health on 20 November 2025 that over 200 hospitals are integrated with Electronic Medical Records systems; he gives no denominator and does not say which hospital tiers, and names no primary facilities.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, under the National Digital Health Blueprint
systems.tiers: at least 7.2 million Nigerians registered; intended to connect public and private, tertiary, secondary and primary
at least 4.5 million users reached with health information
biometric registration of 850,000 residents; digital vaccine tracking; e-medicine consultations reaching 12,000 rural patients monthly
